title: How to apply for a student visa
subtitle: There are several steps you must take when applying for a student visa (F1 visa). The order of these steps and how you complete them may vary depending on the U.S. Embassy or Consulate in each country. Please consult the instructions on the embassy or consulate website
The student visa instruction video below will give you general instructions on how to apply and obtain a student visa.
